lines: Oh! Look what I found under the cot. Mine now.
Battery! Don't look at me like that, I'm keeping it.
Okay, I'll share. Eventually. Maybe after I catch my breath.
You will not believe what just fell out of that locker.
Hey, come look at this relay. I think it's the good one.
Ha, I found a crowbar and I'm thrilled about it.
Oh man, a taser with a full charge. Mine, obviously.
Lockpick! Finally, something that isn't a bent screwdriver.
Stim pack! My legs have been yelling at me all day.
Don't tell the others yet. I want a minute with this.
Score! Two batteries, and I'm only a little guilty about it.
Found a first aid kit. Somebody up there likes me today.
This fuse is going to save us, I can feel it.
Ugh, my flashlight's dead. Good thing this battery showed up.
A music box! Who even brings a music box down here?
Keep this in your pack, please. I'm terrible at holding things.
Oh good, a rescue axe. My hands are too shaky for anything small.
That's a clean keycard. I'd bet it opens something good.
Got it! My shoulder hurts, but this was worth the reach.
Found this wedged behind a pipe. Took me forever to reach it.
Some wire! Could be useful, could be junk. I'll keep it anyway.
Hah, I grabbed the crowbar before you could blink.
Stop hovering, I've got it. Honestly, I've got it.
I'm keeping the bandages until somebody starts bleeding. Kidding, mostly.
Look at this! The good stuff's been hiding under the bench.
Heh. Whoever dropped this was in a real hurry.
I'm not proud of this, but I'm pocketing the spare battery.
Lucky me, a lockpick that still has all its pieces.
My hands are shaking so bad I nearly dropped the lockpick.
Hey, you want the taser, or should I hang onto it?
Honestly, the taser's yours. I don't trust myself with it.
Okay, a relay. Somebody actually cared about this place once.
That fuse is ugly, but I love it right now.
Crowbar's crusty, gross, and totally mine until you ask nicely.
Ha! I call dibs on the stim pack. Sorry, not sorry.
Wait, is that a stim pack? Hand it over, please.
Somebody's going to be mad we found this first. Too bad.
Ooh, a music box. It's a little creepy, but I like it.
I know, I know, I should share. Give me a second.
Got the cable. My hands are cold and I'm proud of myself.
Look, I'm not hoarding. I'm just really attached to this battery.
Okay, fine, I was going to keep the second battery. Here.
I'd feel bad about the bandages, but I'm bleeding a little too.
This is the best thing I've picked up all day. Sorry, everyone.
Ha, the wrench is rusty, but my fingers are rustier.
Finally, a screwdriver that isn't snapped in half.
Pliers! I'm going to act like I knew they were there.
That's one sweet find. I'm keeping it close for a while.
Oh no, the vent's open. Somebody definitely crawled out.
Not gonna lie, I'm glad this thing still works.
Got the crowbar! I'm strong now. Don't test me.
Nobody touch this box until I open it. Please.
Wow, somebody left a whole stash. Lucky us, honestly.
Keep your voice down. I don't want anyone else grabbing this.
Oh, bandages! Sweet, I was about to use my sleeve.
Grabbed the taser. It's heavier than I thought it'd be.
This lockpick looks fancy. I'll make it work somehow.
Oh good, a lighter. Now I can finally see my own feet.
My flashlight's been whining for hours. This battery fixes it.
Hey, don't be jealous. You get the next one, I promise.
Take the cable. I'll take the bandages and the blame.
We're not out of this yet, but this helps a ton.
Whoa, this is nicer than the junk we found earlier.
Ha, I didn't even check what it was before grabbing it.
Under the table, sticky and weird, but I'll take it.
Nice. Now I've got something to swing at the next bad thing.
I'm way too excited about this battery. Don't judge me.
Can you believe this? Somebody just left it sitting here.
Found a bag of spare bolts. Thrilling, I know.
Oof, this thing's heavy. My shoulder's going to complain.
Hold still, I'm going to dig this out of the drawer.
You're going to hate that I got this first, probably.
Okay, this one's still warm, so somebody was just here.
I laughed out loud when I saw this. Not sure why.
Honestly, a second taser would be nice. Just saying.
I'm so tired my eyes hurt, but this helps a little.
Please don't drop that one, it's the last good one.
Thanks for waiting. I was starting to panic in here.
Oh, a granola bar! I love you, granola bar. Mine.
A cold can of soda? Don't ask how it's still cold.
